summary: Adia Med, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on October 9, 2026 it fully repaid and discharged its unsecured revolving line of credit with CEO Larry Powalisz as lender. The facility, originated June 30, 2024 and later increased to a $1,000,000 commitment, bore 6% interest per annum calculated daily. Repayment comprised $500,000 on October 7, 2026 and $434,970.94 on October 9, 2026, of which $74,658.94 was accrued interest, totaling $934,970.94. The lender acknowledged full satisfaction. This is a related-party debt extinguishment, not a special situation; no deal terms, premium, or arbitrage angle apply. Watch for related-party disclosure and liquidity implications.
